import re

# Get list of files in the meetings directory
files = apis.file_system.show_directory(access_token=access_token, directory_path='~/documents/work/meetings/', entry_type='files')

# Process each file
for file_path in files:
    # Extract filename from path
    filename = file_path.split('/')[-1]
    # Split on '__' to get date and rest
    if '__' not in filename:
        continue  # skip if not in expected format
    date_part, rest = filename.split('__', 1)
    # rest is like "slides.ppt" or "video_recording.mp4"
    # Split on last '.' to get base and extension
    if '.' not in rest:
        continue
    base, ext = rest.rsplit('.', 1)
    # New directory name is base
    new_dir = f"~/documents/work/meetings/{base}"
    # Create directory if not exists
    apis.file_system.create_directory(access_token=access_token, directory_path=new_dir, recursive=True)
    # New file name: date.ext
    new_filename = f"{date_part}.{ext}"
    dest_path = f"{new_dir}/{new_filename}"
    # Move file
    result = apis.file_system.move_file(
        access_token=access_token,
        source_file_path=file_path,
        destination_file_path=dest_path,
        overwrite=False
    )
    print(f"Moved {file_path} -> {dest_path}")

print("All files moved.")
